info.title: Pidgen Public API: pending workflow type routes
info.description: When to use on the workflow types: GET /api/v1/workflow-types gains, on each item, `when_to_use` (a string of at most 600 characters, or null when the type states none) and `workflow_title` (the display title of the workflow the type is bound to); no other field changes. The route is published; this fragment holds it with WorkflowTypeResource extended by those two fields, neither required, so a server that does not send them yet still matches. When the server publishes them, they are pulled with contracts/openapi.json and this file is deleted. Every route takes the bearer credential and the X-PIDGEN-Account header like the published routes.

get.description: List every ticket type registered in the Account named by X-PIDGEN-Account, ordered by key, with the workflow it is bound to and how many visible Tickets carry it. A Ticket's workflow_type must be one of these keys. Each type carries its When to use (`when_to_use`, null when it states none) and its workflow's display title (`workflow_title`).
